0365__L6_MAS_1__D1592D38.mp3.asr_text: You think the US Army sent us all this way just to show the Germans how we fall back?
0365__L6_MAS_1__D1592D38.mp3.translation: 你以为美国陆军派我们跑这么远，就是给德国人表演怎么撤退？

0366__L6_Tuc_2__AE7A1B1C.mp3.asr_text: We ain't getting through on this road. The crowds are throwing everything they got at us.
0366__L6_Tuc_2__AE7A1B1C.mp3.translation: 这条路过不去。德国佬把能打的全往咱们身上砸。
0366__L6_Tuc_2__AE7A1B1C.mp3.note: crowds疑似Krauts误识别，按德国佬翻译。

0367__L6_MAS_3__D1755C3A.mp3.asr_text: Baker Company are pushing up with the tanks. You think they're going to take this town without help from us, Tucker?
0367__L6_MAS_3__D1755C3A.mp3.translation: B连正跟坦克一起往前打。塔克，你觉得没有咱们帮忙，他们拿得下这座镇子？

0368__L6_MAS_5__D1918B3C.mp3.asr_text: Then we're going in, starting with an assault on that house up ahead.
0368__L6_MAS_5__D1918B3C.mp3.translation: 那就往里打，先拿下前面那栋房子。

0369__L6_MAS_6__D19FA2BD.mp3.asr_text: We'll use this stream to flank their position. Go! Get off the road!
0369__L6_MAS_6__D19FA2BD.mp3.translation: 沿这条小溪绕到他们侧面。快！离开公路！

0370__L6_Tuc_118__C5092B02.mp3.asr_text: What's the news from battalion, Sarge?

0374__L6_Tuc_93__2CE0CBAC.mp3.note: ASR只有TAKE，结合坦克遭遇语境疑似Tank，译文待听音确认。

0375__L6_MAS_117__E14449DE.mp3.asr_text: That's the last of them. The square's secure.
0375__L6_MAS_117__E14449DE.mp3.translation: 全干掉了，广场已经拿下。

0377__L6_MAS_70__6404DDEE.mp3.asr_text: That's Side Street. If we flank the Panzer, we might get close enough to put a dent in it.
0377__L6_MAS_70__6404DDEE.mp3.translation: 走那条小街。绕到坦克侧面，兴许能靠近了给它来一下。

0380__L6_BR1_55__F2379373.mp3.asr_text: Panzer! We got a Panzer on the road to the north!
0380__L6_BR1_55__F2379373.mp3.translation: 坦克！北边路上有辆德军坦克！

0382__L6_MAS_20__5B7CA2D3.mp3.translation: 吉布森，把楼上的房间清干净！

0387__L6_MAS_34__5D69D976.mp3.asr_text: Won't take them long to find out.

0388__L6_MAS_35__5D77F0F7.mp3.asr_text: Hold fire until they're in range. Gibson, be ready on that MG-42.
0388__L6_MAS_35__5D77F0F7.mp3.translation: 等他们进射程再打。吉布森，守好那挺MG42。

0389__L6_MAS_39__5DB04EFB.mp3.asr_text: Keep hitting them! Don't let them regroup!
0389__L6_MAS_39__5DB04EFB.mp3.translation: 继续打！别让他们重新集结！

0390__L6_MAS_81__65C7CE0E.mp3.asr_text: The door, Tucker! Get it open!

0392__L6_Tuc_79_3__3547B3A8.mp3.asr_text: That Panzer's moving! We need to be someplace else!
0392__L6_Tuc_79_3__3547B3A8.mp3.translation: 那辆坦克动了！咱们要换地方！

0394__L6_Tuc_7__AEC090A1.mp3.asr_text: Freezing my ass off here! Krauts better be waiting with a nice log fire in there!
0394__L6_Tuc_7__AEC090A1.mp3.translation: 冷死我了！但愿德国佬生了堆暖和的火等咱们！

0395__L6_BR1_8__B563C0C1.mp3.asr_text: How about some hot lead? That warm you up, Benny?
0395__L6_BR1_8__B563C0C1.mp3.translation: 滚烫的子弹怎么样？够暖和吧，本尼？

0396__L6_MAS_119__E16078E0.mp3.asr_text: The Germans have given up the bridgehead. They're falling back across the Shur River.
0396__L6_MAS_119__E16078E0.mp3.translation: 德军放弃桥头堡了，正在撤过叙尔河。
0396__L6_MAS_119__E16078E0.mp3.note: Shur按此地河名Sûre处理为叙尔河，待听音核对。

0397__L6_MAS_123__E2C0C479.mp3.asr_text: Bastogne's where we're headed to next.

0398__L6_MAS_97__67D133B3.mp3.asr_text: We're not done yet. We need to push up to secure the river crossings in the town center.
0398__L6_MAS_97__67D133B3.mp3.translation: 还没完，要继续推进，拿下镇中心的渡河点。

0399__L6_Tuc_103__C30DDCDE.mp3.asr_text: Looks like they're getting ready to pull out!

0400__L6_MAS_104__DF652ABC.mp3.asr_text: We've caught them cold! Let's move on them fast!
0400__L6_MAS_104__DF652ABC.mp3.translation: 打了他们个措手不及！赶紧压上去！

0402__L6_BR1_100_2__F71B1E6D.mp3.translation: 反坦克火箭筒！二楼窗口！
0402__L6_BR1_100_2__F71B1E6D.mp3.note: PAGEANT TRACK / SECOND FOUR疑似Panzerschreck / second floor，结合窗口与坦克语境拟译，待听音。

0405__L6_BR1_72__F576FE2E.mp3.note: PANJER疑似Panzer谐音，译为德军坦克。

0406__L6_Tuc_73__29771A6E.mp3.asr_text: Aw hell, it's coming this way!

0407__L6_BR1_74__F5932D30.mp3.translation: 咱们在这儿就是活靶子！

0409__L6_Tuc_57__2645C734.mp3.asr_text: Get out, Gibson! Move, you dumb son of a-
0409__L6_Tuc_57__2645C734.mp3.translation: 吉布森，快出来！快点，你这蠢货……

0412__L6_BR1_13__EB4801F5.mp3.asr_text: MORE OF THEM! BY THE BROKEN WALL!

0415__L6_Tuc_44__2466A812.mp3.asr_text: Jeez, I think we just punched the whole crowd division square on the nose.
0415__L6_Tuc_44__2466A812.mp3.translation: 天哪，咱们刚才怕是给整个德国师脸上来了一拳。
0415__L6_Tuc_44__2466A812.mp3.note: crowd division疑似Kraut division，按德国师翻译。

0417__L6_BR1_102__78B1323C.mp3.asr_text: Look out! MG42 left side window!

0418__L6_Mas_102_1__80A4DF6C.mp3.asr_text: Wait for the tank to nail that MG position!
0418__L6_Mas_102_1__80A4DF6C.mp3.translation: 等坦克干掉那个机枪火力点！

0420__L6_Mas_79_1__A20919E9.mp3.asr_text: Find your way through! Keep moving!

0421__L6_Mas_116_1__BC1EF94F.mp3.asr_text: I need the tank forward! What's the holdup?

0423__L6_Tuc_120__C64D4799.mp3.asr_text: In poor order too, I reckon. Look at all the gear they left behind. Not bad for a day's work by the Blue Ridgers.
0423__L6_Tuc_120__C64D4799.mp3.translation: 依我看，撤得还挺狼狈。瞧他们扔下的装备。咱们蓝岭师今天干得不赖。
0423__L6_Tuc_120__C64D4799.mp3.note: Blue Ridgers按部队绰号蓝岭师处理。

0425__L6_MAS_105__DF73423D.mp3.asr_text: We have to secure this square! Keep up the fire!
0425__L6_MAS_105__DF73423D.mp3.translation: 一定要拿下这个广场！继续开火！

0427__L6_BR1_49__F0BB18D8.mp3.asr_text: We got crowds in the yard! To the north!

0429__L6_MAS_51__60A94431.mp3.asr_text: Gibson, get some fire onto them from the bedroom!
0429__L6_MAS_51__60A94431.mp3.translation: 吉布森，到卧室里朝他们开火！

0431__L6_BR1_12__EB39EA74.mp3.translation: 德国人在外头的小棚子里！
0431__L6_BR1_12__EB39EA74.mp3.note: outhouse可指室外小屋或厕所，暂用小棚子，待结合画面校对。

0432__L6_Tuc_64__27D05950.mp3.asr_text: We ain't stopping a tank, Sarge. Not with these pea shooters.
0432__L6_Tuc_64__27D05950.mp3.translation: 中士，咱们这几杆破枪可拦不住坦克。

0433__L6_MAS_65__62967AD4.mp3.asr_text: Alright, we keep moving. Head further into town and hope we run into our own tanks.
0433__L6_MAS_65__62967AD4.mp3.translation: 那就接着走，往镇子里去，希望能碰上咱们的坦克。

0434__L6_BR1_68__F416B295.mp3.asr_text: Infantry in the building across the street!

0435__L6_MAS_75__644B5373.mp3.translation: 快！塔克，把那个门口清出来！

0437__L6_MAS_121__E2A49577.mp3.asr_text: Yeah, well the good news is we tied down at least two Kraut divisions in this sector. That's two divisions that won't be reaching Bastogne.
0437__L6_MAS_121__E2A49577.mp3.translation: 不过好消息是，我们至少在这片地区牵制了两个德国师。这两个师去不了巴斯托涅了。

0439__L6_MAS_76__64596AF4.mp3.asr_text: Tucker, get that damn door open!
0439__L6_MAS_76__64596AF4.mp3.translation: 塔克，把那扇该死的门打开！

0440__L6_Tuc_77__29AF7872.mp3.asr_text: I'm trying! It's jammed on something!
0440__L6_Tuc_77__29AF7872.mp3.translation: 我在弄！不知道被什么卡住了！

0442__L6_BR1_58__F261D9F6.mp3.asr_text: We can't stay here! That tank's gonna bury us!
0442__L6_BR1_58__F261D9F6.mp3.translation: 不能再待在这儿了！那辆坦克会把我们活埋的！

0443__L6_MAS_59__611A0039.mp3.asr_text: Okay, get across the street and regroup in the building opposite!
0443__L6_MAS_59__611A0039.mp3.translation: 穿过街道，到对面的楼里集合！

0444__L6_Tuc_54__261B80B1.mp3.asr_text: That's Shoto-mu's boss! They're pulling back!
0444__L6_Tuc_54__261B80B1.mp3.translation: 这下知道谁厉害了吧！他们往后退了！
0444__L6_Tuc_54__261B80B1.mp3.note: Shoto-mu's boss疑似showed them who's boss，按这下知道谁厉害了吧拟译。

0448__L6_BR1_40__F03C454F.mp3.asr_text: DON'T GIVE HIM A CHANCE TO DEPLOY!

0451__L6_BR1_101__78A31ABB.mp3.asr_text: MG! Upper floor on the right side!

0452__L6_Mas_116_4__BC493FD2.mp3.asr_text: Get clear! The Sherman's gonna blast that position!
0452__L6_Mas_116_4__BC493FD2.mp3.translation: 让开！谢尔曼要轰那个阵地了！

0453__L6_Mas_53_1__94E15CA5.mp3.asr_text: I want fire superiority! Keep it up!
